proposal: Single-storey rear extension to a terraced house

pages.text:
Site: 12 Linnet Row, Eastmere
Dwelling: mid-terrace, 3 bedrooms
Proposal: single-storey rear extension, kitchen
Parking: one off-street space, unchanged

The extension projects 3.6 m beyond the original rear wall.
Walls in buff brick to match the house; flat roof 3.1 m high.
No windows face the neighbours.

We are worried about light to our kitchen window.
The kitchen is our main living room.
